16
17use moka::future::Cache;
18use snafu::OptionExt;
19use table::metadata::TableId;
20use table::table_name::TableName;
21
22use crate::cache::{CacheContainer, Initializer};
23use crate::error;
24use crate::instruction::CacheIdent;
25use crate::key::table_name::{TableNameKey, TableNameManager, TableNameManagerRef};

28/// [TableNameCache] caches the [TableName] to [TableId] mapping.
29pub type TableNameCache = CacheContainer<TableName, TableId, CacheIdent>;
30
31pub type TableNameCacheRef = Arc<TableNameCache>;
32
33/// Constructs a [TableNameCache].
34pub fn new_table_name_cache(
35    name: String,
36    cache: Cache<(usize, TableName), TableId>,
37    kv_backend: KvBackendRef,
38) -> TableNameCache {
39    let table_name_manager = Arc::new(TableNameManager::new(kv_backend));
40    let init = init_factory(table_name_manager.clone());
41
42    CacheContainer::new(name, cache, init, CacheIdent::table_name_key).with_batch_initializer(
43        Arc::new(move |names| {
44            let manager = table_name_manager.clone();
45            Box::pin(async move {
46                let keys = names
47                    .iter()
48                    .map(|name| {
49                        TableNameKey::new(&name.catalog_name, &name.schema_name, &name.table_name)
50                    })
51                    .collect();
52                let ids = manager.batch_get(keys).await?;
53                Ok(names
54                    .into_iter()
55                    .zip(ids)
56                    .filter_map(|(name, id)| id.map(|id| (name, id.table_id())))
57                    .collect())
58            })
59        }),
60    )
61}
62
63fn init_factory(table_name_manager: TableNameManagerRef) -> Initializer<TableName, TableId> {
64    Arc::new(
65        move |TableName {
66                  catalog_name,
67                  schema_name,
68                  table_name,
69              }| {
70            let table_name_manager = table_name_manager.clone();
71            Box::pin(async move {
72                Ok(Some(
73                    table_name_manager
74                        .get(TableNameKey {
75                            catalog: catalog_name,
76                            schema: schema_name,
77                            table: table_name,
78                        })
79                        .await?
80                        .context(error::ValueNotExistSnafu {})?
81                        .table_id(),
82                ))
83            })
84        },
85    )
86}

88#[cfg(test)]
89mod tests {
90    use std::sync::Arc;
91
92    use common_catalog::consts::{DEFAULT_CATALOG_NAME, DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NAME};
93    use moka::future::CacheBuilder;
94
95    use super::*;
96    use crate::kv_backend::memory::MemoryKvBackend;
97    use crate::kv_backend::txn::TxnService;
98
99    #[tokio::test]
100    async fn test_cache_get() {
101        let mem_kv = Arc::new(MemoryKvBackend::default());
102        let cache = CacheBuilder::new(128).build();
103        let cache = new_table_name_cache("test".to_string(), cache, mem_kv.clone());
104        let result = cache
105            .get_by_ref(&TableName {
106                catalog_name: DEFAULT_CATALOG_NAME.to_string(),
107                schema_name: DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NAME.to_string(),
108                table_name: "my_table".to_string(),
109            })
110            .await
111            .unwrap();
112        assert!(result.is_none());
113        // Puts a new value.
114        let table_name_manager = TableNameManager::new(mem_kv.clone());
115        let table_id = 1024;
116        let txn = table_name_manager
117            .build_create_txn(
118                &TableNameKey {
119                    catalog: DEFAULT_CATALOG_NAME,
120                    schema: DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NAME,
121                    table: "my_table",
122                },
123                table_id,
124            )
125            .unwrap();
126        mem_kv.txn(txn).await.unwrap();
127        let got = cache
128            .get_by_ref(&TableName {
129                catalog_name: DEFAULT_CATALOG_NAME.to_string(),
130                schema_name: DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NAME.to_string(),
131                table_name: "my_table".to_string(),
132            })
133            .await
134            .unwrap()
135            .unwrap();
136        assert_eq!(got, table_id);
137    }
138
139    #[tokio::test]
140    async fn test_lookup_after_same_name_recreation() {
141        use crate::cache::new_table_info_cache;
142        use crate::ddl::test_util::create_table::test_create_table_task;
143        use crate::key::TableMetadataManager;
144        use crate::key::table_route::TableRouteValue;
145
146        let kv = Arc::new(MemoryKvBackend::default());
147        let metadata = TableMetadataManager::new(kv.clone());
148        let names = new_table_name_cache("names".into(), Cache::new(128), kv.clone());
149        let infos = new_table_info_cache("infos".into(), Cache::new(128), kv);
150        let route = TableRouteValue::physical(vec![]);
151        let old = test_create_table_task("my_table", 1024).table_info;
152        let new = test_create_table_task("my_table", 1025).table_info;
153        let name = TableName {
154            catalog_name: old.catalog_name.clone(),
155            schema_name: old.schema_name.clone(),
156            table_name: old.name.clone(),
157        };
158        metadata
159            .create_table_metadata(old, route.clone(), Default::default())
160            .await
161            .unwrap();
162        assert_eq!(names.get_by_ref(&name).await.unwrap(), Some(1024));
163        assert!(infos.get(1024).await.unwrap().is_some());
164
165        metadata
166            .delete_table_metadata(1024, &name, &route, &Default::default(), None)
167            .await
168            .unwrap();
169        metadata
170            .create_table_metadata(new, route, Default::default())
171            .await
172            .unwrap();
173        let tokens = [
174            CacheIdent::TableName(name.clone()),
175            CacheIdent::TableId(1024),
176        ];
177        names.invalidate(&tokens).await.unwrap();
178        infos.invalidate(&tokens).await.unwrap();
179
180        let ids = names.get_many(&[name]).await.unwrap();
181        assert_eq!(ids, [Some(1025)]);
182        let result = infos.get_many(&[1024, ids[0].unwrap()]).await.unwrap();
183        assert!(result[0].is_none());
184        assert_eq!(result[1].as_ref().unwrap().ident.table_id, 1025);
185    }
186}
